简介: Edmund Donovan: Edmund holds a BFA from the Boston University School of Theatre as well as training from the London Academy of Music and Dramatic Art. In Summer 2014, Edmund was seen on the third season of CBS's Unforgettable as well as the second season of Orange Is The New Black. In Fall 2013, Edmund was a part of the Broadway company of MTC's The Snow Geese. Other stage: The Beauty Queen of Leenane (Shakespeare & Company), Macbeth (Actors’ Shakespeare Project), Hot Fun in the Summertime (Cherry Lane), Authentic Lesbian Cuisine (Manhattan Rep).
